notes.title: Beta Test Recruitment(Closed)
notes.notes:
Beta Testers Wanted!
We’re looking for dedicated players to help enhance the quality of Nomadic Tale (Harvest Elysium) through a beta test before its official release. If you’re interested in game testing, bug reporting, and helping us improve the final product, we’d love to have you join the team!

Positions Available

English Native Speaker: 1 tester(Closed)
Chinese (Simplified) Native Speaker tester (closed)

Testing Period: Approximately 10 days

Tasks
Verify functionality and report bugs
Check for spelling errors and suggest fixes for any awkward text
Help refine overall game experience

Requirements
Experience with BlackSmith3 or BlackSmith4
Comfortable with R18 content
Available for regular communication (Steam chat )

Compensation
Steam Gift Card as a token of appreciation
A Steam key for the game upon release

Thank you for your interest!
If interested, please reply below or please send a friend request on SteamChat
(You may unfriend after the Beta test is complete.)

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3320340/discussions/0/4628105513087847253/
